answer: A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the grove proves it. Each attempt carries £18 in fees and a 7-day delay before the stamp dries, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. The counter asks for Sealed blacksmith workshop seal first, and a seal smiths renew after anvil hearings is the answer it accepts. Every walnut is counted once. One cipher, one entry.
